'''Zashiki-warashi''' {{Lang|ja=座敷童子}} is an Overseer of the [[Fractsidus]] who is first mentioned during [[All That Sunlight Touches]]. They are said to primarily operate in [[Ashinohara]], a region that's been largely destroyed by [[the Lament]].

==Trivia==
===Etymology===
*[[wp:Zashiki-warashi|''Zashiki-warashi'']] {{Lang|ja=座敷童子}} are spirit-like yōkai that in parlors or storage rooms and perform pranks. It is believed that families who saw one would receive good fortune.
